This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

You can see the running version via the health endpoint: `GET /api/v1/health` returns a JSON body including `version` (see docs/API.md). This is backed by src/api/health.ts, which reports the running package version.

Note: I haven't closed the other issues you listed (#4203, #4206, #4304, #4313, #4406) — this run only triages issue-4631, and bulk-closing unrelated issues on a reporter's say-so isn't something I'll do without separate review of each.
